Subscription.Description: mini-SIEM curated security events — logons, privilege use, account and group changes, process creation, service/task installs, and log clearing. Deliberately NOT "everything": this is the high-signal subset, sized to avoid drowning the SIEM (important in a large or clinical environment where volume and PHI exposure both matter).
Subscription.Query:
<QueryList> <!-- Security: authentication, privilege, account/group lifecycle --> <Query Id="0" Path="Security"> <!-- Logon / logoff / special privileges / explicit creds --> <Select Path="Security">*[System[(EventID=4624 or EventID=4625 or EventID=4634 or EventID=4647 or EventID=4648 or EventID=4672)]]</Select> <!-- Account management: user create/enable/disable/delete/pwd, lockout --> <Select Path="Security">*[System[(EventID=4720 or EventID=4722 or EventID=4723 or EventID=4724 or EventID=4725 or EventID=4726 or EventID=4740 or EventID=4767)]]</Select> <!-- Group membership changes (privileged groups matter most) --> <Select Path="Security">*[System[(EventID=4728 or EventID=4732 or EventID=4756 or EventID=4729 or EventID=4733 or EventID=4757)]]</Select> <!-- Process creation (requires audit policy + 4688 enabled) --> <Select Path="Security">*[System[(EventID=4688)]]</Select> <!-- Log cleared / audit policy changed — tampering indicators --> <Select Path="Security">*[System[(EventID=1102 or EventID=4719)]]</Select> <!-- Scheduled task created/updated — persistence --> <Select Path="Security">*[System[(EventID=4698 or EventID=4702)]]</Select> </Query>
<!-- System: service installs, unexpected stops, log service issues --> <Query Id="1" Path="System"> <Select Path="System">*[System[Provider[@Name='Service Control Manager'] and (EventID=7045 or EventID=7040 or EventID=7031 or EventID=7034)]]</Select> <!-- Event log service stopped --> <Select Path="System">*[System[(EventID=104)]]</Select> </Query>
<!-- PowerShell script block logging (if enabled) — high value --> <Query Id="2" Path="Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational"> <Select Path="Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational">*[System[(EventID=4104)]]</Select> </Query>
<!-- Sysmon (if installed) — process/network/image telemetry. Harmless if Sysmon isn't present; the channel just won't exist. --> <Query Id="3" Path="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"> <Select Path="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational">*</Select> </Query> </QueryList>
